explication: eShop is a services-based e-commerce reference application with web and .NET MAUI clients, catalog, basket, identity, and order-processing services. The principal user journey is browsing products, managing a basket, and placing and tracking an order; the tree also shows payment, stock validation, and grace-period processing stages. The README documents an optional AI chatbot. Several service-to-service paths are not visible in the supplied excerpts, so the graph keeps those links out rather than inferring them from names or directory structure.
